goal: Reference data a booking UI loads first. Small, rarely changing, read on every page: must be fast and must reflect the seed exactly.
_doc: Input requests. Locust loads this file, binds {{tokens}}, sends each request, then checks it against expectedFile.

cases.goal: Dealership list returns the seeded branches with their time zone and opening hours (the client needs them to show local times).
Service types carry their duration: the client computes nothing, but shows how long the job takes.
All 8 vehicle types from the lookup table are listed — including the unused MOTORBIKE (types are data, D2).
Look up a vehicle by VIN: the response gives the vehicle type derived from its model, which the client then passes to /availability.
Unknown VIN is a 404 ProblemDetail (not 500, not an empty 200).
